reason: Static field flow established the producer and consumer, but it drops the map key before table B; a raw U32 value without a semantic key and F06OF-side typed field receipt cannot answer the mapping question.
required_to_prove_one_typed_mapping: hash-bound DEE, meter DLL, job config, and input identities for one selected run
same-run owner token for the task-config ordered map and the native table-B writer
semantic key/type token for one selected task/input map entry; redact the raw key if it can contain a name or identifier
map ordinal plus the source U32 field value (or a hash/token if policy requires) and the native conversion result
destination native table-B row/field token and OAR consumer row-index token on the same native callback stack
an independent F06OF-side typed receipt mapping target slot s to control52[s], word j, and control16[s+1][j] with model callback generation g+1
an explicit typed join between the native metadata key and that F06OF target-slot/word field; numeric equality is insufficient
